title: Preserve a kept named-root acknowledgement across closing focus refresh
outcome: A same-root acknowledgement made during an ordinary turn remains usable at the next opening when the exact claim and root still hold, despite a closing focus or revision refresh.
acceptance: Confirm the ordering and actual focus or revision preconditions, then exercise a Kept acknowledgement made inside a turn with a different focused claim at closing.

The next opening uses the exact still-valid acknowledgement or states a concrete reason it could not apply it. The prior turn’s ownership, fail-closed behavior and distinct-work custody remain intact.
